args.description: One single cohesive LARGE mossy forest ROCK OUTCROP wrapped by thick twisting exposed tree roots, a modular LEFT bottom corner decoration for a 2D fantasy game UI. One connected tall blue-gray rock mass with broad irregular sloping planes, anchored heavily on ground, not a pile or two boulders. Stone itself is continuous from upper shoulder to broad ground base, no gap or wooden bridge separating upper and lower stones. Tall tapered LEFT side, broad foot curling to RIGHT: asymmetrical L silhouette. Upper and middle two thirds remain narrow in left 45 percent of canvas to leave HUD controls empty on right; flared base spreads right across bottom quarter. Thick brown roots embrace and cross ONE main stone, sparse moss on ledges, a few red and pale mushrooms attached in crevices. Rich but clean, chunky readable shapes, subdued natural forest colors, crisp one-pixel contour, connected top-left highlights and simple shadow planes. No smooth shading, no loose tiny pebbles, no scattered floating leaves, no character, no frame, no UI, no ground tile. All root tips complete with transparent clearance on every side. Use reference for ancient forest stone/root mood, not its buttons or text.

args.description: A clean 2 by 2 sheet of four separate small native pixel-art FOREST DRESSING SPRITES, with wide transparent gutters separating each sprite completely. Top right: three PALE ochre and ivory mushrooms of different sizes sharing one base. Bottom left: a compact tuft of rounded moss and three broad green leaves for a rock ledge. Bottom right: small trailing moss with four leaves, no flowers. Each cluster is only about 20x20 drawn pixels inside its quadrant. Chunky controlled silhouettes, dark outline, simple connected top-left lighting, broad quiet color planes, no individual noisy highlights, no blur or dithering. Natural enchanted forest plants, no rocks, no pots, no ground tile, no UI. Complete silhouettes fully inside their cells.
